response_property_constraints.description: The limit field in the response must be between 0 and 50 inclusive, matching the query parameter constraint.
The offset field in the response must be a non-negative integer.
The total field must be a non-negative integer representing the total number of items available.
The number of items returned must not exceed the limit value in the response.
Each album's album_type must be one of 'album', 'single', or 'compilation'.
The type field of each album item must be 'album'.
The uri field of each album item must follow the Spotify URI format 'spotify:album:<id>'.
The href field of each album item must be a valid URL pointing to the Spotify Web API endpoint for albums.
Each image in the images array of an album item must have a URL starting with 'http://' or 'https://'.
Each entry in available_markets must be a 2-character ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (uppercase letters).
The release_date_precision field must be one of 'year', 'month', or 'day'.
When release_date_precision is 'day', the release_date must match the format YYYY-MM-DD. When 'month', YYYY-MM. When 'year', YYYY.
The total_tracks field of each album item must be a positive integer.
The type field of each artist within album items must be 'artist'.
The URI of each artist within album items must follow the Spotify URI format 'spotify:artist:<id>'.
If the offset plus the number of returned items is less than total, next must be a non-null URL. If all items have been returned, next must be null.
If offset is 0, previous must be null. If offset is greater than 0, previous should be a non-null URL.
The href field of the page must be a valid URL starting with 'https://api.spotify.com'.

request_response_constraints.description: The limit value in the response must equal the limit query parameter provided in the request. If not provided, it defaults to 20.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: The maximum number of items to return

request_response_constraints.description: The offset value in the response must equal the offset query parameter provided in the request. If not provided, it defaults to 0.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: The index of the first item to return

request_response_constraints.description: When the include_groups parameter is provided, every album item's album_group must be one of the values specified in include_groups.
